opening: Remember that Tokyo teammate from last time—the one who clicked your Preview Deployment link and saw your app frozen in amber, exactly as you built it thirty seconds ago? Here's the magic trick we skipped: when they clicked that link, the code didn't travel from Virginia to Tokyo. It didn't lumber across an ocean fiber cable while your teammate watched a loading spinner. Instead, it executed instantly—in Tokyo. Less than 50 milliseconds between click and pixel.
